title: A Mixtape for the Scholarship
author: Cyrus Galloway
blurb: Lena Villalobos, a scholarship student at an academy with too many secrets, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. Then grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before graduation.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
